name: debug
description: Rank hypotheses for a symptom, test them one per fresh context until one is confirmed, then fix only after a checkpoint. Usage: /debug <symptom>, or /debug '{ "symptom": "...", "repro"?, "maxHypotheses"? }'

questions.placeholder: Leave empty to use the failure this session was already discussing

questions.prompt: debug: command that reproduces it (exit 0 means fixed)
questions.placeholder: Leave empty if there is no single command

questions.prompt: debug: how many hypotheses to test before giving up?
